name: recent-searches-field
title: Recent searches field
description: A search field that remembers: focus it and your recent queries appear, each removable, with a clear all action and full keyboard use.
docs: recent is the list, newest first, and onRecentChange hands back the new list when a search runs (it moves to the top, and the same search from earlier is not kept twice), when one is removed and when all are cleared: the field stores nothing, so the history can live in state, local storage or on a server. onSearch(query) runs on Enter or when a recent search is chosen. While the field is focused and empty the list opens (max entries, 6 by default); once text is typed it narrows to the recent searches that begin with it, ignoring case and accents, with the typed part in bold, and when nothing matches the panel stays shut. The focus never leaves the input: the arrow keys move a highlight that is announced through aria-activedescendant, Enter runs the highlighted search or the text, Delete removes the highlighted one, Clear all is the last row, and Escape closes the panel, then clears the text, then leaves the field. The count is announced when the panel opens and as typing changes it, and removals are announced too. emptyText is the quiet line for a field with no history, label names the field, value, defaultValue and onValueChange control the text, placement keeps the panel under (or over) the field instead of letting it flip when there is no room, and defaultOpen starts with the panel open. rememberSearch, forgetSearch, matchRecent and foldSearch are exported from recent-searches-field/recents for your own storage code.
